message.content:
Here are some of the most highly regarded sushi spots in Los Angeles (as of my last update in 2024). I’ve grouped them by vibe/price range so you can pick what fits your mood:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Price Range | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|-------------|------------|
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | $30–$70 per person | Classic omakase, fresh fish, intimate setting |
| **Nobu Malibu** | Malibu (just outside LA) | $80–$150 per person | Celebrity‑famous Nobu style, ocean view |
| **Matsuhisa** | Beverly Hills | $60–$120 per person | Chef Nobu’s flagship, creative fusion |
| **KazuNori** | Downtown / West Hollywood | $20–$50 per person | Affordable, high‑quality nigiri & rolls |
| **Sushi Taro** | Koreatown | $25–$55 per person | Hidden gem, excellent sashimi |
| **Umi** | Santa Monica | $35–$75 per person | Contemporary, seasonal ingredients |
| **Yamashiro** | West Hollywood | $40–$90 per person | Omakase with a modern twist |
| **Sushi Katsu** | Westside | $15–$45 per person | Great value, friendly atmosphere |

If you’re looking for something specific—like vegan options, a particular price point, or a place with a great view—let me know and I can narrow it down further!
